name: Uzum Market
description: Manage an Uzum Market (Uzbekistan) seller account from an AI agent: shops, products and SKUs, FBS and DBS orders, stock, prices, sales and seller expenses, supply and return invoices. 16 tools on the official seller OpenAPI, one API token.
instructions:
This connector uses the Uzum Market seller OpenAPI (`https://api-seller.uzum.uz/api/seller-openapi`).

**Setup**:
1. Sign in to the Uzum Market seller cabinet (https://seller.uzum.uz) with the account that owns the shops.
2. Open the settings and create an API token in the API section.
3. Copy the token into `UZUM_API_TOKEN`.

**Authentication**: the token goes into the `Authorization` header as is, without a `Bearer` prefix (Uzum documents it this way). A 401 or 403 means the token is wrong, revoked, or belongs to another seller.

**Where to start**: `uzum_market_list_shops` returns the shops the token can see. Almost every other tool needs a `shop_id` (or `shop_ids`) from it. Then:
- products and SKUs with their stock and statuses: `uzum_market_list_products`;
- new orders to process: `uzum_market_list_orders` with status `CREATED` (default), then `uzum_market_confirm_order` or `uzum_market_cancel_order`;
- stock for FBS and DBS: `uzum_market_list_stocks`, then `uzum_market_update_stocks`;
- money: `uzum_market_list_sales` (sold items with commission and seller profit) and `uzum_market_list_expenses` (fees and services charged).

**Dates** in filters (`date_from`, `date_to`) are Unix timestamps in milliseconds, for example 1727427283895. Dates in answers are ISO strings or millisecond timestamps.

**Pagination**: page numbers start at 0. Orders and returns allow at most 50 per page, FBS invoices 20, stock 100. `uzum_market_list_stocks` also has a cursor mode: pass `sku_id_from` = 0, then the skuId of the last item, until the list is empty; it is the stable way to read a whole catalogue.

**Order statuses**: CREATED (new, to confirm), PACKING, PENDING_DELIVERY, DELIVERING, DELIVERED, ACCEPTED_AT_DP, DELIVERED_TO_CUSTOMER_DELIVERY_POINT, COMPLETED, CANCELED, PENDING_CANCELLATION, RETURNED. Orders have to be confirmed before their acceptUntil time, otherwise Uzum cancels them.

**Personal data**: DBS orders carry the buyer's name, phone and address in `deliveryInfo`. Only pass them on where the task needs them.

**Rate limits**: Uzum enforces a per-second and a per-day request budget per token and reports it in the response headers `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Burst-Capacity`, `X-RateLimit-Limit-Per-Day` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining-Per-Day`. Read pages one at a time and back off on HTTP 429.

**Writes**: `uzum_market_update_stocks` sets absolute FBS/DBS stock per SKU (identified by its barcode), `uzum_market_update_prices` changes full and sale prices of a product's SKUs, `uzum_market_confirm_order` and `uzum_market_cancel_order` change an order. All act on the live shop.

UZUM_API_TOKEN.label: API token
UZUM_API_TOKEN.help: Seller cabinet (seller.uzum.uz) > Settings > API: create a token and copy it. Paste it without the word Bearer.
UZUM_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the token alone, without Bearer in front and without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Uzum Market refused the token. Check that it was copied whole, without Bearer in front, and that it was not revoked in the seller cabinet.
verifyHints.403: Uzum Market refused the token for this request. Check that the token belongs to the seller who owns the shop.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Uzum Market limits requests per second and per day for each token. Wait a moment and try again.

tools.name: uzum_market_list_shops
tools.description: List the seller's own shops (id and name). Call this first: the shop id is needed by the product, order, price, sales and invoice tools.

tools.name: uzum_market_list_products
tools.description: List the products of one shop with their SKUs: product id, category, status, moderation, commission, and per SKU the skuId, barcode, price and stock quantities (active, FBS, sold, returned). Paginated by page and size.

search_query.description: Search text matched against product title and description.

product_rank.description: Optional ABC rank of products to show.

tools.name: uzum_market_list_orders
tools.description: List FBS and DBS orders of one or more shops in one status (default CREATED, the new orders to confirm): id, status, dates, acceptUntil and deliverUntil deadlines, price, items, drop-off point and delivery info. Up to 50 per page.

shop_ids.description: Shop ids from uzum_market_list_shops, for example [12345].

status.description: Order status to list. Default CREATED.

scheme.description: Fulfilment scheme. Omit for both FBS and DBS.

date_from.description: Only orders from this moment, Unix time in milliseconds.

date_to.description: Only orders up to this moment, Unix time in milliseconds.

size.description: Orders per page, at most 50. Default 20.

tools.name: uzum_market_count_orders
tools.description: Count FBS orders by status (default CREATED), shop and date range. A cheap way to see how many new orders wait for confirmation before listing them.

shop_ids.description: Optional shop ids from uzum_market_list_shops. Omit for all shops.

status.description: Order status to count. Default CREATED.

date_from.description: Only orders from this moment, Unix time in milliseconds.

date_to.description: Only orders up to this moment, Unix time in milliseconds.

tools.name: uzum_market_get_order
tools.description: Get one FBS or DBS order by id: status and all status dates, deadlines, price, items, invoice number, time slot, drop-off point and, for DBS, delivery info.

tools.name: uzum_market_confirm_order
tools.description: Confirm a new (CREATED) FBS or DBS order so it moves to packing. Must happen before the order's acceptUntil time. Returns the updated order.

order_id.description: Id of the order to confirm, from uzum_market_list_orders.

tools.name: uzum_market_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an FBS or DBS order with a reason (for example OUT_OF_STOCK). Cannot be undone, and cancellations affect the seller's rating.

order_id.description: Id of the order to cancel.

tools.name: uzum_market_list_cancel_reasons
tools.description: List the reason codes Uzum accepts when an order is cancelled or returned (OUT_OF_STOCK, OUT_OF_TIME, OTHER, ...). Reference data for uzum_market_cancel_order.

tools.name: uzum_market_list_stocks
tools.description: List FBS and DBS stock per SKU across the seller's shops: skuId, titles, barcode, amount, and whether FBS or DBS is allowed and linked. Page mode (newest skuId first) or cursor mode with sku_id_from (ascending, recommended for a full read).

page.description: Page number starting at 0. Do not combine with sku_id_from.

sku_id_from.description: Cursor: return SKUs with skuId greater than this, ascending. 0 for the first page, then the skuId of the last item. Do not combine with page.

tools.name: uzum_market_update_stocks
tools.description: Set the FBS and DBS stock of one or more SKUs. Each entry overwrites the amount of the SKU identified by its Uzum barcode. Changes what buyers can order; read back with uzum_market_list_stocks.

items.description: SKU stock entries, for example [{"barcode": "2000000123456", "amount": 10}]. barcode and amount are required; skuId may be added.

barcode.description: Barcode of the SKU on Uzum, from uzum_market_list_stocks.

tools.name: uzum_market_update_prices
tools.description: Change the full price and sale price of the SKUs of one product in a shop. Prices are in Uzbek som. Changes live prices; check them afterwards with uzum_market_list_products.

skus.description: SKUs of that product with their new prices, for example [{"skuId": 111, "fullPrice": 150000, "sellPrice": 120000}].

tools.name: uzum_market_list_sales
tools.description: List sold order items of one or more shops from the finance section: order and item, price, quantity, commission, seller profit, status (TO_WITHDRAW, PROCESSING, CANCELED, PARTIALLY_CANCELLED) and dates. Use for revenue and payout questions.

date_from.description: From this moment, Unix time in milliseconds.

date_to.description: Up to this moment, Unix time in milliseconds.

group.description: true groups items by product; false (default) returns one row per order item.

tools.name: uzum_market_list_expenses
tools.description: List the seller's expenses charged by Uzum (logistics, storage, services and other payments): name, source, shop, amount, price, status and dates, as OUTCOME or INCOME. Filter by shop, period and source.

date_from.description: From this moment, Unix time in milliseconds.

date_to.description: Up to this moment, Unix time in milliseconds.

sources.description: Optional expense sources to filter by, as returned in the source field.

tools.name: uzum_market_list_supply_invoices
tools.description: List FBO supply invoices (deliveries of goods to Uzum warehouses) of one shop: invoice number, status, dates, quantities sent and accepted, and price.

tools.name: uzum_market_list_fbs_invoices
tools.description: List FBS invoices (hand-over documents that group FBS orders for a drop-off point) by status: number, status, order counts, prices, drop-off point and time slot. Up to 20 per page.

statuses.description: Invoice statuses to list, for example ["CREATED"].

language.description: Language of status texts: uz (default) or ru.

tools.name: uzum_market_list_returns
tools.description: List the seller's return invoices (goods coming back from Uzum warehouses: defects, returns, FBS): id, type, status, dates and returned SKUs with amounts. One return via return_id.

return_id.description: Optional return id; omit to list all returns.
